# Nu är det dags att ta hem vinst

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-11-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Kort & Lång (DI) hosts Julia Forsberg Thorlin and Agneta Jönsson start with the macro picture: rates are rising after hot inflation data, a December hike is widely expected, the Iran conflict is unresolved, and money is flowing out of Asian tech ahead of Anthropic's expected IPO. They also cover the Nvidia CEO turmoil ahead of its report. The main theme is taking profits after big runs. They recommend taking profits in the elder-care stocks Ambea and Attendo because valuations are stretched, the Humana integration carries risk and political risk remains, and in Apotea. They are wavering on Bravida, and see Revolution Race as an undervalued stock ready for a comeback.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 AMBEA — Ambea | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host recommends taking profits after a 38% gain. Valuation has rerated to about 16x P/E vs a historical average of about 11x; the Humana integration weighs on 2027 margins.

#### Reasoning

Host view: the strong Q3 (profit +18%, margin up to 15.2%) is priced in. P/E is near 16x this year and 15x next, vs a historical average just under 11x. The Humana deal gives 120m in synergies, but integration usually takes longer than expected, and the 9.5% EBITA margin target slips to 2028. Political risks include left-leaning municipalities, LSS reimbursement and abolition of the karensdag (first unpaid sick day). Better to take the safe option than the uncertain one.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation falls back towards historical P/E
- if Humana integration delivers synergies faster than expected
- if political risk (karensdag, LOV) clearly eases

> *"så tycker jag ändå att det är bättre att ta det säkra för det osäkra här och plocka hem lite vinst faktiskt i de här bolagen."*

---

### 🔴 ATT — Attendo | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Take profits after a 62% gain. P/E near 18 is above the historical average of about 17; occupancy and acquisition gains vary over time; political risk.

#### Reasoning

Host view: the record quarter (profit +15%, 8% above expectations, Scandinavia margin 7.7% to 10.4%) came partly from occupancy and acquisitions, which fluctuate. Only the central cost savings are expected to last. The valuation is now above its historical average. Political risk from the left-leaning bloc covers the free-choice law (LOV), reimbursement levels and the karensdag. Lower debt and better profitability are acknowledged.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation de-rates below historical average
- if margin gains prove structural over several quarters
- if political risk recedes

> *"plocka hem lite vinst faktiskt i de här bolagen."*

---

### 🔴 APOTEA — Apotea | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host's earlier Veckans aktie pick is up about 75%. The valuation has run away, leaving little upside even if the company keeps delivering.

#### Reasoning

Host view: the company should keep developing well, but the share price already reflects it. Beating the market from here would need a lot. In an uncertain market, take profits and redeploy into names with more upside. The co-host agrees.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation pulls back materially
- if growth accelerates well beyond expectations

> *"I ett sånt läge är det kanske bättre att bara ta hem vinsten och helt enkelt satsa på nåt annat där man ser en större uppsida."*

---

### 🟡 BRAV — Bravida | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Buy recommendation from January still stands after a 70% gain, but the host is ambivalent and leans towards reviewing it. P/E is 20 this year and 17 next.

#### Reasoning

Host view: AI data-centre build-out drove the stock, and P/E rerated from 13x to 20x. The host hesitates to downgrade because the construction-cycle part of the business is starting to recover, but suggests holders may find better value elsewhere.

#### Sell Triggers

- if construction recovery stalls
- if valuation stays stretched without earnings upgrades
- if AI data-centre demand slows

> *"Jag har varit lite ambivalent, så den rekommendationen lever fortfarande."*

---

### 🟢 RVRC — Revolution Race | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host sees the stock as undervalued and ready for a comeback. Low expectations, weak Germany already priced in, easier comparisons, AI cost savings, and the fast-growing I can I will acquisition.

#### Reasoning

Host view: organic growth expectations are low, and weakness in the key German market is priced in. Comparisons get easier in coming quarters and the Swedish market shows positive signs (peer Boozt is strong). AI-driven cuts in customer service support already-high margins. I can I will (about 500m revenue vs RVRC's about 2bn, growing faster) is consolidated from Q1 and should drive a rerating. The stock is down this year and since the deal was announced. It needs to prove itself once the acquis

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth keeps deteriorating beyond Germany
- if I can I will fails to grow after consolidation
- if margins fall in the upcoming report

> *"Förväntningarna och värderingen är låga. Det är tufft i Tyskland, men aktien förtjänar en uppvärdering."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Report Tuesday with a new interim CEO amid the leadership crisis. Strong numbers are possible, but the outlook may disappoint after the large decline.

#### Reasoning

Hosts flag the risk of a strong report that still falls short on outlook, because the interim CEO cannot answer strategic questions. A new CEO might tighten Nvidia's vendor financing of other AI firms. They think a full Huang comeback is unlikely.

#### Sell Triggers

- if guidance is weak
- if a new CEO restricts vendor financing

> *"Risken är att vi får en jättestark rapport med bra tillväxt och siffror men att vi inte får tillräckliga bra för framtiden."*

---

### 🟠 KLAR — Klarna | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Reports this week after guiding Q3 down on marketing costs. The new EU consumer credit directive may make things tougher for BNPL.

#### Reasoning

Hosts will watch commentary on the outlook and on customer reaction to the stricter credit checks under the new directive. Longer term, the directive could hurt BNPL players in Europe.

#### Sell Triggers

- if guidance is cut again
- if the credit directive visibly dents volumes

> *"så i förlängningen så kanske det gör det lite tuffare för den typen av aktörer som klarnar på den europeiska marknaden."*
